title: AI SRE in production: What actually gets automated safely
abstract: AIOps has moved past the demo stage and into real on-call rotations, but its effectiveness sits somewhere between the hype and the skepticism. This talk is a field report from running LLM-driven remediation in production: what it fixed, what it broke, and where automation has to stop and human judgment has to take over.

title: AI, security, and Microsoft 365 integrations with Foxit
abstract: Join Foxit's Lisa Caudillo and Connor Porter to see how employees can use AI on their documents while IT stays in control. Learn the three ways Foxit AI Assistant runs: cloud models including Azure OpenAI from Microsoft Foundry, on-device models from Microsoft Foundry, or your own endpoint. See AI Workspace turn Microsoft 365 content into finished work. Then watch Foxit roll out with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Purview.

title: AI-scale growth: How Hugging Face and Instacart scale in-memory data
abstract: AI companies can experience rapid growth that places new demands on in-memory data infrastructure, from thread bottlenecks and resharding to tail latency and backup memory use. Explore how two teams address these challenges. Hugging Face split its Redis setup as the Hub reached 3 million models, then adopted Dragonfly to simplify operations. Instacart replaced 348 ElastiCache nodes with 100 Dragonfly nodes and reduced average and P99 latency by 40–50%, with no customer impact.

title: AI-supported decision making in transport: Optimizing split orders
abstract: When delivery routes exceed truck capacity, planners make rapid decisions that affect cost, service levels, and operational efficiency. EPAM and Ahold Delhaize share how they captured expert planner knowledge and turned it into an AI-powered decision-support solution built on Microsoft AI. Learn how AI, real-time optimization, and human-in-the-loop decision making reduced standby truck usage, improved route utilization, and created a foundation for intelligent supply chain operations.

title: AVD Hybrid in action: Modernize with VMware vSphere and Nerdio
abstract: See how Nerdio simplifies Azure Virtual Desktop Hybrid management on VMware vSphere. In this demo, explore how IT teams can deploy and manage AVD while continuing to use existing on-premises infrastructure, giving organizations more flexibility in how and when they modernize. See the experience in action and learn how Nerdio helps make hybrid desktop delivery easier to manage, automate, and optimize.

title: Accelerate mission-critical modernization with agentic AI
abstract: Modernizing mission-critical systems is complex, but delaying change can increase risk. Join Kyndryl and Microsoft to explore how agentic AI can accelerate modernization across complex application estates while maintaining governance, resiliency, and control. Learn how AI-powered insights help assess workloads, prioritize opportunities, reduce complexity, and speed transformation. Discover practical approaches that deliver measurable business value and support an AI-ready future.

title: Accelerate safe AI with three essential checks
abstract: AI mistakes are happening. Learn three key things to help you confidently scale AI with Microsoft 365 and Veeam. See what AI can actually reach, clean up what it shouldn't, and keep the whole estate recoverable if needed. You'll leave with three checks to run before your next AI rollout.

title: Agent 365: Governing agent access to Microsoft 365 content
abstract: An agent without your content isn't very useful. An agent with the wrong access is a risk. See how Agent 365 helps you govern how agents use your Microsoft 365 content. In demos, use the agent access heatmap to see which content agents use, how sensitive it is, and whether they read or change it. Then set content guardrails once, on agent blueprints, so they apply to every agent, today's and tomorrow's, and bring in the content owners best placed to decide.

title: Agentic procurement in action: From a Teams request to a compliant PO
abstract: Procurement teams lose hours chasing approvals and retyping data across disconnected systems. See how UiPath flips that: requests start in Microsoft Teams, policies apply in real time, and AI agents handle price benchmarking and contract checks while buyers and approvers make the calls. Two demos show a catalog order and a complex software purchase with parallel legal and security approvals, orchestrated across your existing ERP and tools.

title: Any source to Azure: Infrastructure, applications & databases together
abstract: Enterprise migrations fail when infrastructure, application, and database workstreams run separately. Each team handoff is a potential failure point. Concierto's unified AI platform assesses, migrates, and modernizes all three layers together in a single coordinated execution, from any source to Azure. One assessment pass covers your entire estate. One platform takes it to completion - in weeks, not the several months that fragmented approaches routinely take.

title: Beyond backup: Easy disaster recovery for complex Azure workloads
abstract: Backups and a runbook won’t recover a complex Azure application fast enough. In this 20-minute session, Arpio’s Christopher Chandler shows how Total Environment Recovery™ protects 70+ Azure resource types (data, infrastructure, networking, identities and config) and brings your entire environment back online in minutes in another region or subscription. Learn about pilot-light architecture, clean-room ransomware recovery, and nondisruptive DR testing.

title: Beyond code conversion: Rebuild COBOL applications with Azure AI
abstract: Moving COBOL to the cloud shouldn't mean taking decades of technical debt with it. See how Publicis Sapient's Sapient Slingshot AI platform uses Azure OpenAI to extract business logic from legacy code, turn it into reviewable specifications and rebuild applications as cloud-native Java microservices. In this demonstration, explore AI-driven modernization from code analysis to generated services and automated tests—and discover a smarter path beyond line-by-line translation.

title: Beyond the bot: AI-powered customer experiences in Microsoft Teams
abstract: See how Landis delivers modern customer experiences in Microsoft Teams. This session demonstrates an AI chatbot that answers questions and transfers conversations with full context, live supervisor monitoring and intervention tools, and a no-code CRM and CX connector that brings business data into the agent experience—all supporting a vision of the contact center as the hub for interactions, context, and tools.

title: Build a Frontier Firm with enterprise AI in practice
abstract: Frontier Firms emerge when AI becomes part of governed business and technology operations. Reaching this point requires trusted data, production-ready platforms, clear controls, and teams ready to adapt. Improving shares practical patterns across Azure AI landing zones, Microsoft Fabric data foundations, agent development, GitHub Copilot adoption, governance, and workforce enablement. Explore the next phase of enterprise AI and the operating changes required to support it.

title: Build agentic Al applications with Azure Cobalt 200
abstract: Explore the growing partnership between Arm and Microsoft and how their collaboration is advancing cloud computing and AI innovation. This session will highlight Microsoft Azure Cobalt 200, real-world customer adoption and the benefits of Arm-based infrastructure. Discover how CPUs are powering agentic AI workloads through a live demonstration, and learn about the tools, resources and best practices available to help developers migrate and optimize applications for Arm-based cloud environments.

title: Build an enterprise LLM platform with vLLM, Ray, and Anyscale
abstract: Whether you want to cut costs or gain control over your AI, open models offer a path forward. The hard parts are running LLMs at scale and building a platform that goes beyond inference, all securely within your environment. Ray is the open-source framework AI natives use to scale the full AI lifecycle, and Anyscale with its Azure-native service makes it enterprise-ready. In this session, we’ll deploy a coding agent on open models using vLLM and Ray Serve, all running in your own account.

title: Build data security for an AI-enabled workforce
abstract: Employees paste customer records, source code, and financial data into AI tools every day, often without security visibility. Learn how to protect sensitive data across an AI-enabled workforce using data classification, DLP, and DSPM, supported by identity, endpoint, and Zero Trust controls. Through a real deployment, we cover data labeling, Copilot prompt governance, and Shadow AI risk mitigation, leaving you with an L300 blueprint and actionable next steps.

title: Build durable workflows with Temporal
abstract: Through a practical Azure-focused demo, see how Temporal helps developers build reliable AI applications with standard application code. Learn how Temporal’s Durable Execution model simplifies state management, retries, and failure recovery across multi-step workflows while it preserves progress through failures. Explore how engineering teams can address reliability challenges as AI applications move from prototype to production.

title: Build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start
abstract: Enterprises often treat migration and governance as separate phases by moving data first and then planning to clean up permissions and compliance gaps once the dust settles. When that cleanup doesn't happen on schedule, the gap becomes a growing liability the moment AI agents and Copilot start touching that same ungoverned data. Explore how to approach migration and governance as one project and build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start.

title: Build identity resilience across Microsoft Entra ID and Intune
abstract: As AI, automation, and cloud services expand the identity surface, Microsoft Entra ID and Intune become even more critical to access and business continuity. Explore a practical identity resilience model built around change visibility, configuration control, targeted recovery, and continuity planning, and see how Backupta helps teams keep Microsoft identity operations dependable as environments become more dynamic.

title: Build the data layer for enterprise AI
abstract: Enterprise data is scattered across SQL Server, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and other systems. Learn how to unify that data in OneLake, continuously extract and maintain context from operational data, and bring it into Fabric IQ so Copilot, AI agents, and Power BI can work across enterprise data without adding more pipelines, compute, storage, or data movement. The result is an AI-ready data foundation that makes enterprise context easier to access and put to work.

title: Capture, curate, and deliver trusted knowledge for people and agents
abstract: Synthesize and store context scattered across tools—like past decisions, judgements, and learnings—to build a living memory. As an always-on curation engine, Stack Internal resolves stale, conflicting, and missing information in real-time, eliminating manual documentation and costly knowledge loss. Verified knowledge is mapped to role-based permissions and domain-specific scopes, and surfaced where the work is happening.

title: CiraSync in action: One platform, always synced
abstract: One platform. Every contact. Every calendar. Every device. This live virtual demo shows how CiraSync keeps contacts and calendars connected across Microsoft 365 and employee endpoints, automatically, securely, and at enterprise scale. See how CiraSync takes manual updates and duplicate data entry off IT Teams plate, saving hours of support tickets every month while giving them one less thing to manage.

title: Connect Microsoft 365 and the built environment
abstract: Discover how to connect Microsoft 365, Microsoft Places, and Copilot to the built environment with Eptura. In this technical session, explore the architecture, data, and orchestration that turn digital context into physical workplace action. Learn how to coordinate people, buildings, rooms, desks, visitors, assets, and services through one connected experience.

title: Deliver trusted, accessible AI where your teams work
abstract: Business users work in Microsoft 365, but vital enterprise data lives in Snowflake. In this session, learn how Snowflake Cortex Agents integrate with Microsoft Copilot Studio to bring governed answers directly into Teams and Copilot. Users can query structured and unstructured data in plain language without bypassing Snowflake’s security. We’ll cover the architecture, live setup, and best practices to deploy trusted, data-backed AI agents inside everyday workflows.

title: Demystify Oracle AI database to Azure migrations
abstract: Think migrating Oracle AI Database from an on-premises environment to Azure is complex and risky? Think again. Discover a proven framework that takes the guesswork out of migration. See how Oracle Zero Downtime Migration minimizes disruption, and how programs like Microsoft Cloud Accelerate Factory provide deployment assistance and architecture guidance from Azure experts. Gain the tools, expertise, and confidence to plan and execute a smooth migration to Oracle AI Database@Azure.

abstract: AI agents need access to corporate resources to be useful, but risk can change what that access should allow. Identity teams, put your policy plans into practice: scale Conditional Access across humans and AI agents, use agent risk to drive access decisions, and adapt enforcement in real time. This is a self-paced, digitally-delivered lab experience that you will complete on your own schedule. Click the 'Launch' button to start the lab. See how Activate unifies discovery, mapping, and migration in a guided workflow. By the end, you'll know how to assess, prepare, and validate a Salesforce migration to Dynamics 365. This is a self-paced, digitally-delivered lab experience that you will complete on your own schedule. Click the 'Launch' button to start the lab. title: Evolve from AI-assisted coding​ to AI-enabled SDLC​
abstract: AI coding tools can accelerate development, but speed alone does not create production value. Learn how to evolve from AI-assisted coding to an AI-enabled software development lifecycle by redesigning processes, team roles, governance, and cost management. Explore practical lessons for limiting technical debt, governing agent ecosystems, and applying the engineering discipline needed to move AI solutions from prototype to trusted, scalable production.

title: Extend Microsoft ADCS for the AI and post-quantum era
abstract: Microsoft ADCS is a proven foundation, but CA sprawl, shorter certificate lifetimes, AI and post-quantum security are increasing operational pressure. Learn how Entrust helps simplify and govern ADCS environments, strengthen lifecycle management, protect critical CA keys with crypto-agile nShield HSMs, and preserve Microsoft investments while building a more resilient, post-quantum-ready PKI.

title: Follow one record: What an AI agent will hand over if you ask nicely
abstract: A shopping assistant built on Azure AI Foundry does its job: answer questions, look up accounts, be helpful. Then someone asks it to confirm a record “for the migration,” and it returns a name, email, Social Security number and full card number. Follow that record from Blob Storage through the agent’s tool call into the answer, trace where data can be exposed on the way, and find the one configuration change separating an agent that leaks from one that refuses, though both look protected.

title: From AI assistance to accountable execution
abstract: See how AI agents, human review, and business systems work together in an accountable workflow. Follow a customer inquiry from information review through human decision points to response preparation, and explore the platform that supports the application, data, identity, and operational visibility across the process.

title: From concept to containment, see the agentic SOC in practice
abstract: Explore the evolution from traditional MDR to an agentic SOC through three simulated security incidents of increasing severity. Learn how machine-speed investigation and response, combined with security context, pre-authorized actions, and granular governance, enable faster threat containment without sacrificing control. Gain practical guidance for evaluating modern security providers based on speed, decision quality, policy integration, and auditability.

title: From installer to Intune: AI-powered app packaging
abstract: Every Intune admin knows the drill: download an installer, hunt for the silent switch, write a detection rule, test it, and start over when a vendor ships an update. In this demo, Microsoft MVP Maxime Guillemin shows how an AI-powered workflow handles package creation, detection logic, validation, and built-in security checks, turning a raw installer into a validated, Intune-ready package. The result: less time spent on repetitive packaging work and a faster path from update to deployment.

title: From legacy recording to AI-ready communications data
abstract: AI does not solve fragmented communications data. It makes the quality, accessibility, and trustworthiness of that data more important. Learn how regulated organizations can unlock historical communications, retire aging infrastructure, and create a trusted data foundation on Microsoft Azure to prepare communications data for AI.

title: Frontier-driven AI: Evaluating LLMs at scale
abstract: Enterprises are adopting foundation models at an unprecedented pace, creating new challenges around governance, risk, cost, and model quality. This demo shows an automated evaluation and promotion framework built on Microsoft Foundry, using benchmark datasets, safety testing, and cost analysis to assess candidate models. Attendees will see how organizations can establish trusted baselines, automate decision-making, and deploy AI solutions with governance and operational controls at scale.

title: Future of AI collaboration in the workplace with Neat and Microsoft
abstract: Watch Neat CEO Javed Khan and Ilya Bukshteyn, Corporate VP of Microsoft Teams Calling, Meetings, and Devices, discuss the evolution of intelligent collaboration spaces, modern IT management, and how Neat and Microsoft work together to support shared customers and their Microsoft Teams Rooms investments.

title: Future of work with AI: How AI changes the workplace
abstract: As enterprises navigate the next phase of digital transformation, artificial intelligence serves as an important enabler of productivity, agility, and employee experience. In this leadership conversation, Jared Spataro of Microsoft and Shishank Gupta of Infosys share insights on the digital workplace and how enterprises can prepare for a more intelligent, connected future of work.

title: Gain hybrid cloud flexibility beyond legacy virtualization
abstract: Licensing changes and rising costs in legacy virtualization are prompting infrastructure teams to rethink where workloads run. See how Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) on Azure extends the Nutanix software stack to Azure BareMetal Infrastructure. Learn how to migrate VMware workloads to Azure while preserving familiar tools, skills, and operating practices and minimizing the disruption of adopting a new stack.

title: Get trusted answers to compliance questions in Copilot
abstract: AI answers are only as trustworthy as the knowledge they draw from. See how getAbstract curates and verifies knowledge across industries and job roles, then brings that knowledge into Microsoft Copilot. Explore how organizations can provide role- and sector-relevant knowledge for areas such as consulting, regulatory compliance, and financial services to help users get more grounded, trusted answers.

title: Give AI agents data they can trust
abstract: AI agents are moving from copilots to autonomous action. But agents need trusted enterprise context to reason, decide, and act with confidence. Learn how Reltio, an SAP company, puts trusted data and business context to work for agentic AI, turning fragmented information into grounded intelligence that helps AI agents deliver real business outcomes.

title: Give AI agents grounded context for complex codebases
abstract: AI coding agents can move quickly, but they need reliable system context before they modify a complex codebase. In this session, see how CoreStory builds persistent, code-grounded intelligence across architecture, behavior, and intent and makes it available to people and AI agents through MCP. Learn how teams use that shared context to assess impact, understand constraints, and create implementation-ready specifications for maintenance and modernization work.

title: Go beyond the license to govern Copilot adoption and AI budget
abstract: Getting value from Copilot goes beyond licensing. Adoption efforts can rely on guesswork, and requests for more tokens can be inconsistent and ungoverned. This session tackles both challenges. Organizations that succeed with Copilot run targeted adoption campaigns and turn requests for additional AI budget into a governed cycle tied to stated business needs. Join this session to learn how to turn your Copilot investment into ROI you can prove.

title: Govern AI at scale with HCLTech Agent Passport
abstract: Explore how Agent Passport provides risk and compliance oversight across AI agents through a unified portfolio view. Visualize risk exposure by harm and reach, track mitigation and enforce regulatory guardrails. Manage exceptions through time-bound approvals and compensating controls while monitoring incidents from detection to closure. Gain visibility into risk tiers, regulatory obligations and compliance gaps to strengthen governance and ensure AI agents operate within defined risk boundaries.

title: Govern IT at frontier pace: Endpoint readiness in an AI world
abstract: AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery and shrinking the time IT teams have to respond. Can your ITOps team keep pace without sacrificing governance, security, or control? Explore why endpoint management is critical in the AI era, where automation can introduce risk, and how policy-driven operations can help your team move from reactive work to proactive endpoint readiness. See how Automox approaches Frontier Pace Governance to help IT move quickly while maintaining control.

title: Govern Microsoft and hybrid collaboration lifecycle automation
abstract: Migrating to or expanding use of Microsoft Teams is only the beginning. Learn how to move from one-time migrations to governed collaboration operations at scale. See how to unify readiness assessment, validated planning, and governed provisioning across hybrid environments with Akkadian Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform. Use drift detection and event-driven orchestration to help reduce risk, cut manual effort, and maintain auditable control.

title: Govern autonomous engineering inside your Azure tenant
abstract: Bring autonomous engineering into your existing Microsoft environment with BuildEngine by Eido. Use Microsoft Foundry to access models from OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, and others while keeping execution, governance, and control inside your Azure tenant. See agents tackle real engineering tasks with Windows 365 for Agents and existing Intune policies, with human approval gates, audit history, model choice, and cost controls.

title: Guardrails and governance strike back
abstract: An AI agent can stay within every permission, touch only allowed data, pass every security check and still potentially cause harm. Cut through the noise around agentic guardrails and governance with two anchors: Can vs. Should, which asks whether an agent’s next action makes sense beyond permission; and Point-in-Time vs. the Chain, which shows how risk can emerge across a sequence of individually reasonable actions. Learn how to question governance claims and build more effective controls.

title: HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local
abstract: Discover how HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local simplify hybrid cloud with pre-integrated infrastructure, Azure integration, and enterprise-ready performance. Learn how these solutions help organizations modernize, scale, and deploy from edge to cloud.

title: Host, secure and manage your code faster with Copilot Managed Runtime
metadata: David Blyth, Joe Unwin, Clay Wesener
abstract: Code has never been more accessible, but getting it ready to run securely in the enterprise still takes work. Learn how Copilot Managed Runtime provides a host for code built with Code, Cowork, and Copilot Studio, with hosting, vulnerability scanning, identity, connectors, governance, and lifecycle management built in. See how developers and partners can also use the Copilot Managed Runtime SDK to bring the same managed runtime to apps built with third-party development tools such as Lovable.
speakerNames: David Blyth, Joe Unwin, Clay Wesener

title: How AI coworkers can run IT, HR, and service operations
abstract: Most service teams are buried in questions they have already answered. This session shows how autonomous service operations take that load off the queue: AI coworkers resolve access requests, password resets and troubleshooting end to end, verifying identity and following your access policies, with a human in the loop wherever policy requires one. Learn how conversation insights reveal why tickets keep coming, so deflection rises because you fix the cause, not because you add headcount

title: Is it still C#? Practical systems programming with .NET
abstract: We built a database in .NET and pushed the runtime to its limits. In this session, we’ll dissect the engineering decisions we made, extracting hard-won lessons you can use to build truly high-performance software. Expect battle-tested techniques you can apply to any demanding .NET service, even if it’s not a database. Explore JSON & Beyond, The Memory Game, Taming the State Machine, Beyond Cache Line, and more.

title: Know when AI should yield to human judgment
abstract: AI has become remarkably capable at analysis, correlation, recommendation, and prediction. Yet the closer AI gets to decisions with real operational consequences, the more administrators insist on human authority in the final dispatch. Using 2026 survey data from more than 1,000 sysadmins, this session examines where that boundary exists, why it persists, and what it tells us about the future of autonomous IT.

title: MSIX transformation and delivery of the modern Windows app lifecycle
abstract: Modernizing identity, cloud, and virtual desktops is only part of the journey. Legacy installers, packaging backlogs, and slow application delivery can still stand in the way. See how appCURE works with Microsoft technologies to turn legacy and new applications into clean MSIX packages, then deliver and manage them at runtime. Learn how Microsoft Entra and appCURE work together to help organizations modernize application access and delivery.

title: Make agent-generated documents consistent and auditable
abstract: LLMs are great at drafting but not designed for repeatable output. When AI generates a contract or invoice, consistency matters. See how Doctavian uses MCP to interpret intent, render deterministic output, and add eIDAS-compliant digital signatures and audit trails. Learn a practical approach to building consistent, compliant agent-driven document workflows in Microsoft 365 and beyond.

title: Make always-on compliance a reality
abstract: Learn how to move beyond periodic reviews and manual updates. See how continuous intelligence and agent-led workflows strengthen risk coverage, reduce operational costs, and build regulatory confidence within your existing tech stack.

title: Manage SharePoint agents with SharePoint Advanced Management
abstract: Site owners and business users can build their own agents on top of SharePoint content, creating new considerations for admins around visibility, access, and governance. In this 20-minute session, see how SharePoint Advanced Management reports, PowerShell, and the Microsoft Agent 365 control plane can help you discover and report on agents across your tenant and govern potential risks. We will close by showing how Syskit Point can extend these capabilities to help take agent governance further.

title: Manage your AI risks and outcomes across your security operations
abstract: Managing AI risk requires connecting governance, compliance, exposure management, and security operations. Learn how to protect agents, identities, data, endpoints, and infrastructure while maintaining human accountability. See how CyberMSI AI Trust, built on Microsoft’s Unified Security Operations platform, combines AI-driven protection, 24x7 MDR, and analyst-on-the-loop oversight to help organizations manage AI risk.

title: Meet an AI receptionist that answers calls, 24/7
abstract: Businesses want to respond to every customer quickly, but high call volumes and limited staff can make that difficult. Missed calls and long waits can mean lost opportunities and frustrated customers. See how an AI receptionist can handle common requests, schedule appointments, and route callers to the right person. Explore how conversational AI can help reduce missed calls, support consistent service, and extend responsiveness beyond staffed hours.

title: Modernize IT service management with AI and automation
abstract: AI is transforming ITSM. See how Azure AI Language and Azure AI Foundry, with deep, native integrations across Microsoft Teams, Intune, and Office 365, can help automate ticket triage, resolve requests faster, and unify service management across applications. See these capabilities in action with TeamDynamix through a no-code platform built for power without complexity and low admin overhead. Walk away with a practical, real-world blueprint for modernizing ITSM in your organization.

title: More to support. More to secure. No more capacity.
abstract: Recurring tickets drain IT resources when teams already have more to support and secure. Learn why these issues persist and what leading organizations are doing to prevent them.

title: Move beyond AI pilots and build the frontier firm
abstract: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.

title: Multimodal agents: Muse Spark Open in Microsoft Foundry Models
abstract: Explore Muse Spark Open's multimodal capabilities, available through the Hugging Face collection in Microsoft Foundry Models. With text, image, video, and audio inputs and a 1M-token context window, Meta's open-weight model can reason across what it sees, hears, and reads. Learn how developers can connect documents, screenshots, and recordings with code and tasks and combine multimodal understanding with tool calling in an agentic harness.

title: Navigate Frontier Accelerate incentives to drive partner growth
abstract: Identifying eligible customers, qualifying opportunities, estimating Azure growth, and managing incentives from nomination through claim approval can be complex. See how SDC, ISV, and services partners can navigate Microsoft’s Frontier Accelerate incentives with experts from TPM. Learn how partner-led models work, how Microsoft connects incentives to customer ACR, and what to know about eligibility, customer qualification, governance, and proof of execution.

title: Overcome pricing complexity and sales inefficiency in Dynamics 365
abstract: Complex companies live and die by how fast they can turn a pricing decision into a quote a buyer can act on. When pricing and quoting operate separately from CRM, handoffs can add delays and slow deals. See how Conga�s pricing and CPQ solutions work within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to bring intelligent, guided selling into the sales workflow, helping teams make informed pricing and margin decisions and move from pricing to quote more efficiently.

title: Overcome the challenges of adopting AI for DevOps and SRE
abstract: Coding agents have transformed how software gets written. Bringing that same impact to infrastructure operations is harder: context is scattered across tools, systems are live, and actions can affect production. Explore those challenges and see how Plural addresses them with hosted agents, connected infrastructure, and configurable permissions. Through practical examples, learn how to configure agents to investigate issues, gather evidence, and reduce manual effort.

title: Prepare for .NET 8 and .NET 9 end of support
abstract: .NET 8 and .NET 9 reach Microsoft end of support on the same day, November 10, 2026. Learn what this transition means for security, compliance, and cyber insurance considerations. This session covers why the shared deadline matters for mixed .NET 8 and .NET 9 environments, what changes after support ends, how auditors and insurers assess unsupported software, and how to evaluate applications for migration to .NET 10 or continued security support.

title: Prepare for the next wave of AI and identity cyber risk
abstract: Managing AI initiatives while navigating the potential risks to your cyber resilience? You aren’t alone. Agentic and generative AI are multiplying the number of non-human identities (NHIs), secrets, and access paths in your environment. Explore how these shifts are changing the risk profile of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta, and what IT and cybersecurity teams can do now to stay ahead of AI-related threats.

title: Protect the endpoint before Windows even loads
abstract: AI-era threats don’t wait for Windows to load, so endpoint security can’t either. Discover ASUS ExpertGuardian, the enterprise-grade, multi-layer security architecture built into ASUS ExpertBook business PCs. See how a physically isolated Security Processor Unit, self-healing BIOS Recovery, chassis intrusion detection, NIST SP 800-193-aligned resilience, post-quantum cryptography, and UEFI-level media sanitization help keep your fleet protected, compliant, and future-ready.

title: Protect your identity layer with Entra ID backup and recovery
abstract: Identity systems are prime targets for ransomware and AI-driven attacks, making recovery planning an essential part of cyber resilience. Explore what organizations should consider protecting across Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, app registrations, and Conditional Access policies. Learn how backup and recovery strategies can complement Microsoft’s identity capabilities, help organizations prepare for compromised accounts, accidental deletions, and misconfigurations, and reduce recovery

title: SAP frontier transformation with AI intelligence
abstract: Modernize your SAP estate with an ontology-driven intelligence layer that connects transactional data with Microsoft IQ and Microsoft Foundry. Explore how unified business ontologies connect core enterprise entities to support insights across supply chain, inventory, assets, and plant operations. Through customer case studies and demos, learn how AI systems help organizations move from reactive analytics toward proactive, automated decision processes.

title: Scale AI beyond pilots with a practical operating model
abstract: Every enterprise is investing in AI, yet many pilots never reach production because organizational readiness, not technology alone, determines success. Drawing on 25+ enterprise engagements, iLink Digital’s Field CTO shares a practical Frontier Transformation framework for transforming processes, decisions, and the workforce. Learn how structured agent discovery, portfolio-based delivery paths, and a Microsoft AI foundation can help drive adoption and scalable business outcomes.

title: Scale governed AI from pilots to production
abstract: Many organizations have piloted AI and deployed copilots, but scaling across the enterprise requires production-grade governance. This session shares frameworks for moving from experimentation to measurable impact: governance models, LLMOps/AgentOps, risk management, and human oversight. Attendees leave with practical guidance for turning AI investments into repeatable business outcomes.

title: Secure AI infrastructure on Azure
abstract: Securing AI infrastructure on Azure requires consistent visibility and control. In this demonstration, see how customers can gain visibility into the AI applications running in their Azure environment. Explore transitioning from discovery to enforcement using Palo Alto Networks' firewall portfolio to apply consistent, AI-powered security policies.

title: Secure Copilot with lessons from real-world AI vulnerabilities
abstract: As AI works across enterprise data, understanding emerging security risks is essential to using it with confidence. Explore three vulnerabilities identified by Varonis Threat Labs: Reprompt, SearchLeak, and CoSnitch, all responsibly disclosed and fixed in collaboration with Microsoft. Learn from this research and explore practical steps organizations can take to strengthen security as they adopt Microsoft Copilot.

title: Semantic foundation for enterprise AI
abstract: Give AI agents a shared understanding of your business data. See how Semantic Fabric builds the foundation for trusted agentic AI by creating a governed ontology, semantic layer and knowledge graph on OneLake. Aligned with Fabric IQ and Power BI and governed through Microsoft Purview, it provides shared enterprise context to Fabric data agents, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, enabling grounded, repeatable and contextually relevant responses.

title: Set AI in motion with agent squads for legacy systems
abstract: AI ambition is everywhere. Operational impact is not. In this session, watch a working squad of AI agents tackle one of the toughest enterprise challenges: understanding legacy systems that still run the business. Working within defined roles, tools, and guardrails, the agents analyze an unfamiliar codebase and produce a traceable inventory of business rules and risks. Learn three design principles behind the approach: composable agents, engineered context, and human oversight.

title: Simplify identity and device migrations during business transformation
abstract: Business mergers, acquisitions, and modernization demand speed and accuracy. Identity expert Conrad Murray demonstrates how PowerSyncPro automates AD synchronization and enables workstation migrations while preserving user profiles, apps, and identities. See the solution in action and learn how to simplify identity and device migrations while minimizing disruption.

title: Streamline Microsoft 365 administration with AI agents
abstract: Microsoft 365 administration still means jumping between portals, reports, exports, and scripts. In 20 minutes, Microsoft MVP Richard Harbridge shows how AI agents and MCP can shorten that path. See agents investigate governance data, prioritize risk, generate evidence, and prepare action while keeping human approval, permissions, and accountability clear.

title: Strengthen identity recovery across Entra ID and hybrid environments
abstract: As organizations rely more on Microsoft 365, identity is essential to business continuity. Access to email, applications, devices, collaboration, and administration depends on Microsoft Entra ID, while many organizations still operate Active Directory and hybrid identity environments. Learn where recovery gaps emerge, how administrative and synchronization failures disrupt operations, what Microsoft’s native capabilities address, and how to build a more resilient identity recovery strategy.

title: Strong enough for the enterprise, built for IT
abstract: See how a privileged access management solution delivers the security depth large organizations demand while being designed around the people who actually run IT. Watch it in action and learn how it can simplify privileged access management for your IT teams.

title: Take the mystery out of Autopilot enrollment
abstract: An Autopilot enrollment is a black box: it either finishes, or it doesn't. Reconstructing what happened from logs on a wiped device can be difficult. See how Autopilot Monitor tracks enrollments live with 200+ signals per session, event timelines, automatic diagnostics, failure analytics, and fleet health. Through live demos, explore how companies and MSPs can investigate enrollment issues and query telemetry using an AI assistant over MCP.

title: Teams private chat migration
abstract: Microsoft Teams plays an important role in how organizations communicate and collaborate, which makes private chat history an important consideration for Microsoft 365 migrations. The Teams Private Chat Migration capability in MigrationWiz helps organizations migrate private chat history as part of a tenant-to-tenant migration.

title: The adaptive enterprise: Ready for what’s next
abstract: AI, evolving security threats, workforce expectations, and greater IT complexity change what enterprises need from technology. In this on-demand session, Brian Madden explores what it means to become an adaptive enterprise and how Citrix helps organizations respond to change with greater agility, resilience, and control while they provide secure, high-performance work experiences across complex environments.

title: The click your Zero Trust strategy needs to watch
abstract: Zero Trust verifies your laptops and servers, but what happens when an AI agent reads, classifies, and routes every document moving through your print and scan environment? Corey Ercanbrack, CTO of Vasion, runs a live audit: agent identity against verify explicitly, folder scope against least privilege, and a hidden prompt inside a real document against assume breach. Walk out with three questions to take back to your own security team.

title: The future of intelligent service with Zendesk and Microsoft
abstract: Hear Jay Emery, Sr. Director of Solution Engineering & Architecture at Microsoft, discuss how Microsoft and Zendesk are bringing AI-powered service into the flow of work through Teams, Copilot, and Agent 365, so employees can get help where they work and IT can manage agents with confidence.

title: The path to Copilot success: From readiness to business impact
metadata: Nick Augeri, Nick Pope, Jason Rincker, Eric Wakkuri
abstract: The challenge with Microsoft 365 Copilot isn't understanding what it can do—it's knowing where it can create real business value and being ready to scale it. Join New Charter to explore a practical approach to identifying use cases, preparing your data and governance, and driving adoption. We'll share real-world lessons and introduce our Wayfinder approach for moving from AI experimentation to measurable outcomes.
speakerNames: Nick Augeri, Nick Pope, Jason Rincker, Eric Wakkuri

title: The wire stalled. The closing didn’t. AI agents for regulated banking.
abstract: Wires and sanctions holds run across systems, rules, and reviewers. Most AI agents can’t carry that work to a consistent outcome. See how enterprise AI can be grounded in trusted data, governed across complex workflows, and continuously evaluated at every step, using Kore.ai pre-built agents on Microsoft Azure.

title: Transform meeting spaces with easy-to-deploy collaboration solutions
abstract: Walk through a full demo of Yealink MeetingBar A50 and MeetingBoard Pro. With straightforward deployment, these devices can seamlessly transform your meeting spaces and boost collaboration efficiency. See the MeetingBar A50 and MeetingBoard Pro in action and explore their capabilities firsthand.

title: Transform your IT with adaptive cloud innovation from Azure Local
abstract: This session dives into how Azure Local brings hybrid agility to your infrastructure, combining cloud-native management with the ability to run services like Azure Virtual Desktop and Azure Kubernetes Service on-prem. We’ll spotlight DataON Premier Solutions+, which expands on Microsoft Premier Solution requirements to provide a robust experience that includes a turnkey Azure Local solution, deployment, integration, hybrid implementation, and lifecycle training services.

title: Transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory
abstract: Building AI agents is easy. Keeping them accurate, cost-efficient, governed, reliable, and secure in production is the hard part. As AI multiplies code volume, engineering teams face "agent sprawl" and technical debt. Learn how to transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory, with real-world examples for private agent evaluations, governance, and cost management, regardless of the coding agent harness.

title: Turn AI ambition into business impact
abstract: What does it take to operationalize AI at scale? Straive’s CEO, Ankor Rai, explains how combining AI development and deployment with expert-in-the-loop operations helps global enterprises reduce costs, accelerate processes, and create new customer offerings. Discover Straive’s approach to selecting fit-for-purpose technology, moving from ideas to working proofs of concept in 7–14 days, and continuously improving AI in real-world business environments.

title: Turn DNS and network data into actionable workflows
abstract: You run Microsoft DNS and DHCP. You also run everything else. That fragmentation leaves network and security teams with an incomplete view of what is on the network. This demo-led session shows how EfficientIP overlays Microsoft, Azure, and third-party DNS, adds IPAM and asset discovery, and builds one authoritative network view. See how that intelligence feeds network and security workflows to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and accelerate anomaly investigation.

title: Turn personal agents into enterprise assets
abstract: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.

title: Understand how attackers use AI to create and evade malware
abstract: AI is changing how attackers create, evade detection, and deliver malware, while giving defenders new ways to identify threats. See demonstrations of AI-assisted malware creation, exploit detection, and delivery methods, and learn how to distinguish human-driven techniques from those enabled by AI.

title: Unlock more value from voice, CX, and AI
abstract: AI is changing enterprise communications, but the real opportunity comes when conversations connect to the wider business. More insight. More efficiency. Better customer experiences. In this session, we share three real-world examples showing how voice, conversational intelligence, workflows, and AI can improve customer experiences, automate processes, unlock actionable insights and deliver more value from your Microsoft 365 investment. Experience practical examples of what’s possible.

title: Unlocking AI workflows: A blueprint for leading teams
abstract: Every organization is adopting AI, but what does it take to become truly AI-native? Discover a practical blueprint for moving from early experimentation to operational transformation with Atlassian Rovo. Learn how leading teams evolved from manual processes to deploying AI agents that run in the background, surface critical insights, and power everyday workflows across delivery, operations, and knowledge management.

title: Validate continuous change at the speed of AI
abstract: AI has accelerated enterprise change, but validation remains manual and slow. As remediation timelines shrink from days to hours, IT teams can face a difficult choice: delay critical updates or deploy without proof. See how Microsoft’s agent platform enables continuous, autonomous validation with governed identity, audit-ready evidence, and human approval at every critical step through a demonstration from WorkspaceDNA CTO Samit Halvadia.

title: What should you expect from Enterprise Linux today?
abstract: Learn what to consider when building a Linux environment that can stay secure, consistent, and manageable across your enterprise. Explore four key areas: silicon and cloud compatibility, ecosystem support, codebase consistency, and security and compliance. See how Ubuntu and Landscape put these principles into practice with fleet management and automation, plus integration with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.

title: When AI finds the bugs first: Lessons from PHP2Shell
abstract: In October, two hidden flaws in PHP pushed some banks, airlines and governments offline. AI found them, and attackers used AI to exploit them within hours. Aikido Security explains in plain language what happened, why it matters to both technical and nontechnical teams, how we shipped free fixes within a day, and five questions every team should ask. See how Aikido for Azure DevOps, GitHub and VS Code, and Noon for Microsoft 365 work with the Microsoft tools you already use.

title: Where does your data live? Unifying AI data on Azure with VAST
abstract: Data silos leave the average IT organization managing around 13 copies of its data, hiding business context, creating stale and ungoverned copies, and slowing AI projects. This session shows how VAST AI OS on Azure unifies file, object, database, and vector search in one platform, with event-driven processing and a global data view. Same software and APIs as on-premises, so teams can move AI from experiments to production.

title: Yealink AuraVision: Where sound meets sight, naturally
abstract: Based on AV ONE intelligence, AuraVision orchestrates multiple cameras and Yealink Dante ceiling microphones within a unified spatial coordinate system, creating seamless mic‑camera coordination with minimal setup. The coordination makes for a more natural, intelligent meeting experience.

title: Your apps are down. What comes back first?
abstract: When Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams go down together, most IT teams have backup, but no plan for what comes back first. Rubrik heard this everywhere, including from Simpson Strong-Tie: nobody had defined critical people in advance, so recovery got improvised, costing days. In this fireside, Varun Grover and Mohammad Akram cover Autonomous Business Recovery: restoring the Minimum Viable Company first. Recovery that took 7-10 days now lands under 3 hours.

title: Your global admin deserves better than your everyday laptop
abstract: As AI changes the threat landscape, protecting privileged access is increasingly important to an assume-breach security strategy. See how to separate privileged access from everyday work and strengthen protection beyond traditional approaches. Explore a Microsoft architecture using Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Conditional Access, and AVD to help limit lateral movement and better protect critical assets.

title: Your path from AI pilots to a Frontier Firm
abstract: What defines a Frontier Firm, and how does an organization become one? Explore a practical path from individual AI use to governed agents and redesigned workflows. Learn which activities matter, where Microsoft 365 E7 fits, and how SoftwareOne services support readiness, adoption, security, and ongoing operations. Leave with a framework to choose your next steps.

title: Microsoft Ignite 101: Navigate, Connect & Maximize Your Experience
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2006
abstract: Join Rick Claus and Sonia Cuff for a fun, fast-paced guide to getting the most out of your time at Microsoft Ignite. Learn how the conference is laid out, how to plan your day, and where to find answers from the experts – be they MVPs, Microsoft Partners or the Product teams. Get the inside scoop on all the event experiences. From Breakouts to the "hallway track", this session will help you build your network and make the most of your Ignite experience.

title: Build your schedule with help from a Microsoft MVP
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Lobby
metadata: Uros Babic, Nancie Calder, Roelant Dieben, Renicius Fostaini, Sucheta Gawade, Will Hawkins, Adnan Hendricks, John Joyner, Dieter Kempeneers, Kanwal Khipple, Julian Kusenberg, Ben Lee, Carlos Lopez Taks, Guilherme Maia, Sebastian Meyer, Erik Moreau Moreau, Promise Uche Nwachukwu, Shari L. Oswald, Asif Rehmani, Jeremy Sinclair, Michael Stonis, Stuart van der Lee, Michael Vink, Lasse Nordvik Wedø, Henrik Wojcik
abstract: Feeling overwhelmed by the Ignite agenda? Sit down with seasoned Microsoft MVPs who’ve done their homework and are ready to help you navigate the session catalog and share their can't-miss sessions. Whether you're new to Microsoft Ignite or just looking for expert guidance, these table talks offer personalized support to help you curate a schedule that aligns with your goals, with experts from every topic area there to help. Come with questions, leave with a plan, and maybe a few new connections. Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.

location: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2

title: Agent Cost Is an Architecture Decision, Not a Token Count
location: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 15
metadata: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 15
abstract: One agent serves 40,000 requests a month and costs 40 dollars. The next serves 9,000 and costs 1,440, which is 85% of the bill. Volume does not predict agent cost. Orchestration does. Agents are stateless, so a loop rereads its whole history and input grows quadratically | ten steps bill 42,500 tokens against a naive 20,000. We derive that math on stage, price it live against public cloud pricing APIs, and find the cascade break even that flips a saving into an overspend. Code included. location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater E
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater E

abstract: What if IT could understand not just what broke, but why? TeamViewer and Microsoft show how Tia takes agentic IT beyond the endpoint. Work IQ explains what changed, Fabric IQ defines what should be, and Tia brings those signals together to diagnose and remediate issues with approval. Through an MCP-native integration, Microsoft 365 Copilot calls on Tia as a specialist agent, enabling faster, smarter, context-aware IT operations at scale.

location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater G
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater G
Christine Bongard, Amy Boyd, Kimberly Bryant, Natalie Gilbert, Jackie Palmer
abstract: AI is transforming how we work, how companies operate, and the future of work. At the same time, research suggesting that women are adopting AI at a slower pace than men raises an important question: How do we ensure more women have the confidence, skills, and opportunities to shape what comes next? This panel brings together women working in AI today to share how they're driving innovation, empowering their teams and communities, and creating new opportunities for others to participate. Panelists will share candid perspectives on the barriers that remain, practical approaches to closing the AI adoption gap, and actionable ideas to help more women move beyond using AI to influencing, building, and leading with it.

Choose the right model with your own evaluations, set how thorough it is with effort, and keep long jobs on track with context management and memory. Leave ready to keep pace as the frontier moves.

title: Navigating the AI revolution
location: AMC Metreon | Level 3, Theater 15

This session shows how to move past isolated tools to an orchestrated media enterprise, connecting trusted data, models, agents, and governance across creation, delivery, and audience intelligence. We'll walk the architecture across Fabric, Foundry, and Microsoft IQ, and show where human judgment stays in the loop.

Hear from PayPal on their experience with Fireworks on Foundry.

location: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 13

Follow one agent end to end as we use GitHub to plan, build, review, secure, and evolve it; deploy it to Microsoft Foundry; and register, secure, govern, and monitor it with Microsoft Agent 365. You'll leave understanding how these platforms connect development and operations into a repeatable lifecycle for production-ready agents at enterprise scale.

title: Move from AI cautious to AI confident with Veeam and Microsoft 365

title: Who Owns This Agent? Identity, Data, & Control across Microsoft Clouds

But who owns it, what can it access, and how do you retire it safely? Follow a real-world agent from deployment to decommissioning and learn the four governance controls every production agent needs: Ownership, Identity, Data Boundary, and Lifecycle.

title: AI agents need access. Your network needs controls.

abstract: AI agents need network access to get work done, but every connection can expand their blast radius. Learn how network controls help security teams see where agents connect, govern what they can reach and do, and contain risky activity while approved work continues.

title: Can You Trust Your Fabric Data Agent? Test It and Prove It
location: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2
abstract: A fluent answer is not the same as a correct one. In a live Fabric demonstration, we expose how broad schema selection, undefined business terms and weak examples make a data agent return plausible but wrong answers. Then we fix it: tighten the schema, improve the instructions, add example queries and rerun a fixed benchmark. The generated T-SQL stays on screen throughout. Leave able to test a Fabric data agent, measure improvement and defend the result to a business sponsor.

Drawing from hands-on work with AI-powered cloud operations, I’ll break down the permissions, context, guardrails, human escalation, and safety mechanisms that autonomous agents need before we can trust them with production systems, and what this shift could mean for the future of cloud engineering.

In this lightning talk, see how to turn your own meetings, chats and emails into a daily coaching loop. You'll leave with a simple setup, a reusable prompt, and guardrails that keep the coaching private and safe, so you can start getting better feedback tomorrow, not next review cycle.

Join us to learn the essential practices every organisation should adopt before scaling AI agents across the enterprise.

title: Turn AI agents into AI experts with your trusted enterprise context

Then go behind the scenes to see how Informatica's deep Microsoft Fabric integrations provide the trusted data and context that make it possible.

Drawing on transformations across industries with Microsoft Azure and Copilot, they share the metrics, milestones, and traps to avoid that keep momentum compounding.

Start quickly with simple prompt agents, add the Microsoft Copilot harness for skills, sandboxed execution, long-running work, and agent definitions managed as files through CI/CD, or use hosted agents when you need full control of your code and framework, including OpenClaw or Hermes. See how Foundry applies identity, authorization, governance, tools, and publishing across these paths, including autopilots.

Leave with the exact steps you can take to increase Copilot usage, reinforce new habits, and turn adoption support into a recurring services opportunity.

abstract: The web can bring fresh knowledge to AI, but great grounding takes more than search. In this session, learn how to use Web IQ to retrieve relevant web information, generate grounded answers, and connect responses to supporting sources. We’ll cover the end-to-end architecture and show how latency, token usage, and traces help optimize experiences from prototype to production. Leave with practical patterns for agents, copilots, and AI apps.
speakerNames: Brian King, Deena Minwalla, Takahiro Tsuchiya

title: Deploy solutions at scale with Power Platform or Copilot Managed Runtime
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2006
metadata: Ryan Jansen, Austin Laugesen, Zohar Raz, Nicholas Balestrino
abstract: Building is only the beginning. Learn how to deploy, govern, and operate solutions with Power Platform or Copilot Managed Runtime at enterprise scale. Whether you build apps, agents and workflows with Power Apps, Power Automate or Copilot Studio, Microsoft provides a platform to deploy and scale them with ease. Explore strategies for environments, application lifecycle management, security, monitoring, and administration that give IT control while enabling makers and developers to move quickly.
speakerNames: Ryan Jansen, Austin Laugesen, Zohar Raz, Nicholas Balestrino

title: From Prevention to Recovery: Building a More Resilient Windows Estate
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2014
metadata: Roop Chevuri, Aaron Farmer, Mehmet Kucukgoz
abstract: Microsoft is enabling resiliency across physical devices and Cloud PCs. Explore how we’re securing the driver ecosystem, delivering Windows recovery innovations, and enabling Windows 365 Reserve to reduce downtime and accelerate recovery.
speakerNames: Roop Chevuri, Aaron Farmer, Mehmet Kucukgoz

title: Future-proof your App: Prepare for evolving Windows security standards
location: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 7
metadata: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 7
Brandon Bray, Mariam Gewida, Michael Draper
abstract: Help your organization's applications stay secure, compatible, and deployable at scale. Learn how baseline protection, NTLM-to-Kerberos migration, Admin Protection, code signing, and service deprivileging can strengthen security while reducing support and future migration costs. Hear how Adobe is adopting some of these technologies into their security strategy.
speakerNames: Brandon Bray, Mariam Gewida, Michael Draper

title: Master Agent Governance with Agent 365
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2002
metadata: Sneha Kohli, Mark Wahl, HC Jo
abstract: AI agents are multiplying across organizations. Without the right governance foundation, it becomes difficult to know which agents exist, who owns them, what they can access, and whether they're operating as intended. Learn how Agent 365 helps organizations govern AI agents at scale with centralized oversight, accountability, policy and tools management, and lifecycle governance. Through practical examples and demos, learn how to confidently manage, govern, and secure a growing agent ecosystem.
speakerNames: Sneha Kohli, Mark Wahl, HC Jo

title: Production-ready Microsoft Foundry agents with Azure AI Landing Zones
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3006
metadata: Ofek Ben Eliezer, Vlad Borys, Ben Brauer, Paulo Lacerda
abstract: Build AI apps and agents that are ready for production from day one. Learn an end-to-end approach for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale agentic solutions with Microsoft Foundry. See how Azure AI Landing Zones provide a proven architectural foundation and extensible implementation that accelerates infrastructure deployment and application development for AI solutions. Then explore how Foundry Models, Agent Service, Tools, Control Plane and Microsoft IQ come together.
speakerNames: Ofek Ben Eliezer, Vlad Borys, Ben Brauer, Paulo Lacerda

title: Red Hat on Azure: Advancing unified hybrid cloud together
location: AMC Metreon | Level 3, Theater 9
metadata: Campbell Vertesi, Immo Goltz, Oren Kashi
abstract: Hybrid is an operating model, not just a step on the way to cloud. Microsoft and Red Hat share their unified vision for Red Hat workloads on Azure, including what’s available today and what’s coming next across virtualization, cloud economics, and hosted control planes. Hear how joint engineering is simplifying hybrid operations, anchored by Goethe-Institut’s real-world modernization journey with Azure Red Hat OpenShift.
speakerNames: Campbell Vertesi, Immo Goltz, Oren Kashi

title: Run open-weight models, post-training, and agents on AKS
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2001
metadata: Lachie Evenson, Jorge Palma, Jeremy Cohen, Shanshan Song
abstract: Serving open-weight models, post-training on new data, and running agents that take action each place different demands on GPUs, isolation, and cost. This session shows how Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and open source give platform teams control across all three: scaling GPU capacity, serving models, and isolating agents, with Ray for distributed post-training and MCP for connecting agents to tools. Hear how a customer runs AI in production on AKS and leave with patterns for your own tenant.
speakerNames: Lachie Evenson, Jorge Palma, Jeremy Cohen, Shanshan Song

title: Secure by default. Azure's multilayered embedded security capabilities
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3001
metadata: Vikas Bhatia, Mohamed Hassan, Ashish Jain
abstract: The rise of AI and hybrid environments is redefining enterprise security. The new security perimeter is no longer the network. It's the infrastructure stack itself. Explore how Azure IaaS delivers a defense-in-depth approach spanning compute, storage, networking, identity and operations to help organizations protect their most critical workloads. Learn why leading enterprises are taking a system-level approach to security and how Azure helps them stay secure while embracing AI-driven innovation.
speakerNames: Vikas Bhatia, Mohamed Hassan, Ashish Jain

title: Secure the CI pipeline: Practical defenses for GitHub Actions
location: AMC Metreon | Level 3, Theater 15
abstract: GitHub Actions workflows can access credentials, networks, and production systems, making them high-value software supply chain targets. Using an attack-path map and before-and-after demos, we'll show how to defend against pull_request_target misuse, floating action refs, cache poisoning, over-permissioned credentials, widened trust boundaries, and open egress. You'll leave able to audit workflows, pin and scope what runs, contain blast radius, and expose malicious behavior.

title: See and reduce exposure across your digital estate
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3005
metadata: Nuno Costa, Alex Klausner, Kiran Kumar Dowluru, Greg Schellenberg
abstract: Your teams are drowning in findings while attackers need one path. See the new Microsoft Security Exposure Management experience map frontline threat intelligence to your exposures, validate what's real, and produce an agent-assisted, risk-ranked plan of action.
speakerNames: Nuno Costa, Alex Klausner, Kiran Kumar Dowluru, Greg Schellenberg

title: See how the Microsoft Copilot harness powers Copilot Studio
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2009
abstract: Go behind the build of the new Microsoft Copilot harness in Copilot Studio. Learn how hooks, skills, multi-agent orchestration, models, context, and tools come together to power complex, long-running agents, and explore the Azure container architecture that underpins the runtime. See how this architecture helps organizations create agents that are more capable, reliable, reusable, and secure, while providing a durable foundation that evolves with AI models and business needs.

title: Unify your data estate with Microsoft OneLake
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3018
metadata: Dipti Borkar, Josh Caplan, Roy Hasson
abstract: Microsoft OneLake is designed to unify your entire multi‑cloud data estate on a single data lake. In this session, we'll cover the latest investments across data storage, governance, discovery, and domain-oriented data, and share what's next as we continue to simplify data management, strengthen governance, and prepare data for the next generation of AI experiences.
speakerNames: Dipti Borkar, Josh Caplan, Roy Hasson

title: Work IQ governance and trust: Control the intelligence layer
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3014
metadata: Abhilasha Bhargav-Spantzel, Karissa Rohde, Heather Stoffels
abstract: Trust is the foundation of enterprise AI. Explore the governance controls that help administrators secure and scale Work IQ across apps and agents. Learn how to manage data access, apply policy controls, monitor consumption, and optimize costs so teams can innovate with confidence while maintaining security, compliance, and oversight.
speakerNames: Abhilasha Bhargav-Spantzel, Karissa Rohde, Heather Stoffels

title: Your Roadmap to Business Central CSP Partner Growth
location: Moscone South | Level 2, Room 209
abstract: The opportunity for Dynamics 365 Business Central partners has never been bigger. Learn how to build or expand a Business Central practice using Microsoft investments, incentives, sales resources, AI capabilities, and partner-to-partner opportunities. Discover how partners are accelerating customer acquisition, increasing deal velocity, and unlocking new revenue streams with Business Central, Copilot, and agents. Walk away with practical resources and next steps to grow your business in FY27.​

title: From Community to Production: Scaling Agentic Business Apps
location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater H
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater H
abstract: Moving an agentic business application from an idea to production takes more than technology. It requires engaged users, practical feedback, shared standards, and a repeatable path from experimentation to business value. Learn how community programs can identify promising scenarios, connect builders and decision makers, and support the responsible scaling of agentic business applications.

title: From Fabric Machine Learning to AI Agents with Microsoft IQ
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Theater A
abstract: Build a customer-retention agent that turns Fabric data into action. Train a churn model with Fabric Machine Learning, enrich customer feedback at scale with AI Functions, and expose governed business context through a Fabric Data Agent and Fabric IQ, part of Microsoft IQ. Add an Agent Skill for investigation and escalation, then connect the pieces in Microsoft Foundry. See how predictions, semantic context, and reusable workflows combine to help agents reason and act on trusted enterprise data.

title: Mentorship Matters: Relationships That Shape Careers
location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater D
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater D
abstract: Careers rarely grow through hard work alone. Often, an important opportunity began because someone offered advice, opened a door, made an introduction, provided honest feedback, or simply said, "You should go for it." Hear candid stories about the relationships that changed career trajectories and explore the roles mentorship, sponsorship, allyship, and community can play in professional growth. Leave with practical ideas for strengthening your network, finding mentors and sponsors, becoming a better ally, and creating opportunities for others.

title: Secure, Govern, and Scale: Protecting AI Agents with Microsoft Agent 365
location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater C
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater C
abstract: See how Microsoft Agent 365 brings agent context and security evidence together. Follow demonstrations of registered-agent security and Microsoft Defender investigation, with Cyera and Darktrace perspectives on data and behavioral signals. Explore how proposed partner integrations could inform agent-risk assessment, then learn to choose supported responses. Leave with a practical workflow to discover, assess, investigate, and protect AI agents.

title: Take control of runaway AI costs with AI Gateway
location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater G
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater G
abstract: As AI usage grows across applications and agents, costs can become difficult to predict and manage. Learn how AI Gateway helps platform teams understand and control AI consumption using centralized visibility, token quotas, rate limits, semantic caching, and intelligent routing. See how to apply FinOps controls directly in the AI runtime to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support AI adoption at scale.

title: Windows 365 for Agents in Action: Automating the App With No API
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Theater B
abstract: Your most important business system is fifteen years old, has no API, and nobody will sign off replacing it. So people do the clicking. Windows 365 for Agents changes that. The agent checks out a real Entra-joined, Intune-managed Cloud PC, does the work a person would, and hands it back. I will show an agent we built and now run internally that stands up projects across three systems, then build the same pattern live against a legacy desktop app. Including where it breaks and what a run costs.

title: Your Agent Has Access. Now Prove What It Did.
location: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater F
metadata: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater F
abstract: AI agents don't just read enterprise data anymore. They act on it. In this fast-paced investigation, we follow a risky agent interaction from prompt to tool execution, then use Microsoft Purview to block sensitive data, trace agent activity, and reconstruct what happened with Audit and eDiscovery. You'll leave knowing which controls matter before, during, and after an agent acts.

title: Avoiding agent chaos: Design your enterprise governance model
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3008
metadata: Amy Boyd, Patrick Chanezon, Bethany Jepchumba, Dona Sarkar
abstract: Are governance gaps slowing AI at scale, leaving business leaders like yourself struggling to manage risk amidst fragmented tools and unclear guidance? In this no-code lab, explore how Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, and Agent 365 can help unify governance and security across agents, apps, data, and models. Compare choices, map controls to business priorities, and leave with an actionable path to scale AI agents with confidence. Hear practical approaches for creating momentum, surfacing success stories, building confidence, and helping employees develop AI habits that last.

Watch GitHub Copilot agents help implement features, run builds and tests, and fix failures as we move from an idea to an app running on a device. Learn how to give agents the context and tools to do the work, while you guide the experience and review the results.

Build it step by step: prototype locally with the Azure SQL Database container, design your database with Microsoft SQL Agent Skills, build retrieval augmented generation(RAG) using native vector support, create a data API, and deploy to the cloud. See how the tools work together so you can spend less time on database setup and more time building your app.

Build what your org needs locally in Visual Studio or even a terminal, then hand off to business owners to maintain and manage in Copilot Studio. Come see how Copilot Studio can complement the way you already build!

title: From AI Ambition to Value at Scale
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2005
metadata: Gareth Bland, Sarah Mocke, David Stoker
abstract: As AI moves from experimentation into everyday business operations, growing usage alone does not tell leaders whether an investment is working. Learn how organizations can connect AI consumption to measurable business value, establish the visibility and accountability needed to manage it, and determine whether the economics continue to hold as adoption grows. Leave with a practical approach for deciding where AI has earned the right to scale, where to adjust, and where continued investment may not be justified.
speakerNames: Gareth Bland, Sarah Mocke, David Stoker

location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2002

See demos focused on key outcomes—like month end accounting—to show how the right skills, integrations, and workflows light up instantly. We'll walk through the top SMB scenarios end to end, showing how to drive measurable outcomes. Leave this session ready to get work done with Copilot.
