title: The backlog problem gets worse with AI. Here's how to fix it.
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2001
abstract: Getting ready for AI means getting ahead of security debt. As development accelerates, security teams need a better way to prioritize risk than severity scores alone. Learn how organizations identify the vulnerabilities, dependencies, and secrets most likely to matter, then drive remediation at scale through security campaigns and agentic autofix that help teams reduce backlogs and focus on what needs fixing.

title: Trusted code at scale, from legacy to AI
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3014
abstract: Every codebase carries quality debt, and AI adds to it faster than teams can pay down. Performance issues inflate cloud cost, maintainability debt slows every future change, and reliability gaps surface as incidents. GitHub Code Quality catches these across new and existing code where developers work, recommends fixes, and gives engineering leaders governance to enforce standards. Agentic autofix then remediates findings at scale, turning backlogs into reviewable pull requests.

title: What if your data agents spoke your business language
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Skilling Theater
abstract: Your data records what happened, but rarely what it means to your business. In this session we take one real business scenario and build an ontology in Fabric IQ that captures its concepts, relationships and rules, then follow it through into data agents and Foundry. Leave able to model your own domain and give your agents the vocabulary your business actually uses.

title: Reliable by design: Driver Quality Initiative in Action
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Theater A
abstract: Whether you’re an IT professional, security practitioner, or technology partner, discover how Microsoft and its partners are working together to advance driver quality, reduce kernel risk, and shape the future of a more reliable and resilient Windows platform and ecosystem.

title: Why access isn't adoption: GitHub Learn's guide to AI enablement
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Skilling Theater
abstract: AI access is growing, even for non-developers—but access isn't adoption, and training without measurable goals often fails. Join this session to see how GitHub uses proficiency modeling, hands-on skilling, certifications, and learning pathways to drive real impact.

title: Learn in the flow of work with Microsoft Copilot + AI Skills Navigator
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Skilling Theater
abstract: What if your next learning journey began with a question you were already asking at work? For Microsoft Copilot users and leaders, this session shows how Learning Agent uses personal and company context to recommend relevant learning from AI Skills Navigator and your organization. See how a real work need can become a clear next step toward lasting capability—right in the flow of work.

title: AI for frontline workers: Guidance in the flow of work
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3001
metadata: Parag Ladha, Chris Crowley, Jonathan Sobel
abstract: What happens when IT, OT, and AI converge on the factory floor? Big River Steel and Sight Machine share how Azure-powered industrial AI transformed galvanizing operations by connecting process, quality, and business data into a closed-loop optimization system. Learn how industrial AI helped reduce process variability, improve operational efficiency, and deliver sustainable cost savings while maintaining product quality and customer commitments.
speakerNames: Parag Ladha, Chris Crowley, Jonathan Sobel

title: AI-ready data integration with Fabric Data Factory
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2002
abstract: See how Fabric Data Factory helps teams connect, transform, govern, and operationalize enterprise data for AI. Learn patterns for pipelines, Dataflows, Copy Jobs, Mirroring, OneLake integrations, data quality, and analytics engineering with dbt to deliver trusted data for copilots, agents, and analytics. Additionally, learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory workloads to Microsoft Fabric.

title: Bring GitHub Copilot where you work
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3014
abstract: You build software across more than one tool, and GitHub Copilot can meet you in each of them. See how Copilot supports the full development lifecycle across IDEs, the terminal, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and mobile devices. Follow work from planning and building through review, security, and release, choosing from multiple AI models along the way. Understand how Copilot connects these experiences to improve developer flow and help organizations deliver better software faster.

title: Build personalized AI experiences with Work IQ
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2006
abstract: See how information workers and developers use Work IQ to power intelligent experiences across declarative agents, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and third-party platforms. Learn how Work IQ combines organizational context with connectors, agent-to-agent experiences, and external systems to create secure, personalized solutions grounded in your organization's knowledge, processes, and permissions.

title: From models to infrastructure: Confidential AI at Hyperscale on Azure
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2014
abstract: Learn how Azure Confidential VMs on the next-generation VR72 platform help organizations run frontier-scale AI workloads with hardware-backed protection for models, prompts, data, and infrastructure, enabling trusted AI innovation without compromising performance or scale.

title: How Microsoft Connects Employees, Leaders, and Knowledge at Scale
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2001
abstract: In the AI era, trust is your organization's most important capability. Join Microsoft Corporate Communications and product leaders to learn how Microsoft supports 200K+ employees through workplace transformation. Discover practical strategies to create clarity during change, build psychological safety, scale shared knowledge, and accelerate AI skills through leadership engagement, communities, Teams events, Copilot, and agents—and preview upcoming Viva Engage and Microsoft 365 innovations.

title: Japan Wrap-up Session
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3004
abstract: 本セッションでは、Microsoft Ignite で発表された主要なアナウンスと技術的インサイトを、日本からご参加の皆様に向けて日本語で凝縮して解説します。マイクロソフトのロードマップが、アーキテクチャ、セキュリティ、運用、データ、開発ワークフロー、そしてビジネス戦略に何をもたらすのか。本セッションにご参加いただくことで、すぐに実践に活かせる知見と、「何が変わり、なぜ重要で、自組織として次に何を検討すべきか」という社内共有に使える明確なストーリーを、あわせてお持ち帰りいただけます。 A focused recap of key Microsoft Ignite announcements and technical insights, delivered in Japanese.

title: Model to mission: Azure Infra for agentic enterprise
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2009
abstract: AI innovation goes beyond models and GPUs. Enterprise value comes from the complete cloud system connecting compute, data, networking, storage, security, orchestration, and applications. This session follows an AI request across Azure to show how an open, connected infrastructure helps organizations build with Microsoft or their technology of choice and operate at enterprise scale.

title: Secure your data as you scale your agents with Microsoft Purview
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3005
abstract: AI agents can access data and automate work at unprecedented scale. Learn how Microsoft Purview helps discover agent activity, protect sensitive information, detect risk and meet compliance requirements for a growing landscape of AI agents.

title: The evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ
location: Moscone West | Level 3, Room 3002
abstract: Better context leads to better AI applications, but improvement requires more than trial and error. In this session, we'll build an evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ applications, using evaluations to compare retrieval configurations, context strategies, prompts, and models. Learn how to identify weak spots, measure the impact of changes, and systematically improve application quality. See how evaluations can transform context engineering from guesswork into an iterative, data-driven practice.

title: Web IQ in action: How enterprises build grounded, governed AI agents
location: Moscone West | Level 2, Room 2005
metadata: Brian King, Deena Minwalla, Lou Barone
abstract: Join Microsoft and a customer to explore how Web IQ enables enterprise-grade AI agents grounded in the public web. Through a real-world customer experience, learn how Web IQ supports high-value business scenarios while meeting enterprise requirements for security, governance, quality, and scale.
